This '''criminal empire''' was run by [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Bogga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], and was based in the [[Stenness Node]]. At its height, around [[3999 BBY]], the empire stretched out six [[Parsec/Legends|parsecs]] in any direction. Bogga ruled his empire from his [[Bogga's palace|estate]] on [[Vo Dasha]], and by 4,000 BBY wielded influence over the [[Stenness Hyperspace Terminal]].
